ai: Not part of habit machinery per se — no AI is used in streak/push/completion logic. AI touches only commentary fallback (unrelated, HomeScreen.tsx:469-472) and is out of scope for this map.

completion_and_streak: Completion is stamped per-path via localStorage key dw_reading_done (en-CA local date string), guarded so each path only writes it once/day (HomeScreen.tsx:719, 587, 1562). Three write sites: (1) handleMarkRead — user taps "Mark as read" on the hero, HomeScreen.tsx:717-731, guarded by dw_reading_done at :719, stamps at :720, calls recordStreakToday() at :723; (2) savePathwayProgressFromLesson — completing a new-believer lesson day, HomeScreen.tsx:584-598, guarded at :587, stamps at :596, dispatches 'dw-reading-completed' event at :598; (3) an auto-completion on the last hero chapter ref when scrolled/expanded, HomeScreen.tsx:1562 guard, :1846/:1852 dispatch 'dw-reading-completed'. Passive app-open also records the streak once/day via a mount effect at HomeScreen.tsx:786-795 (calls recordStreakToday() unconditionally on mount; idempotent). Plan-day completion (markPlanDayComplete, HomeScreen.tsx:702-711) and pathway-day completion (completeTodaysPathwayDay, HomeScreen.tsx:558-579, and savePathwayProgress, HomeScreen.tsx:541-551) also call recordStreakToday() when a NEW day is credited (savePathwayProgress:544-546). The streak itself: single source of truth src/utils/streak.ts, key dw_streak_v2 (storage.ts:35), function recordStreakToday() (streak.ts:41-96). Idempotent per local calendar day (streak.ts:47, 58). Consecutive-day match increments count (streak.ts:70-71). A missed single day is bridged by a "freeze": one freeze available, replenished once 7+ days have passed since it was last spent (streak.ts:65-66); spending a freeze increments count and marks freezeWeek=today (streak.ts:72-75). Missing more than one day resets count to 1 (streak.ts:76). bestCount tracks the longest-ever run and never falls below the live count (streak.ts:30, 80). Milestones are 7/14/30/60/100/365 days (streak.ts:14); recordStreakToday returns isMilestone (streak.ts:87). On every save it pushes to Supabase via pushNow() (streak.ts:81, 94) and dispatches a 'dw-streak-recorded' CustomEvent (streak.ts:83-84) that App.tsx listens for to re-time the push permission ask. GreetingSection.tsx shows a one-time milestone celebration banner ("🔥 Milestone Reached... You've got a {streakCount}-day streak!") gated on MILESTONE_STREAKS (7,14,21,30,40,50,60,75,100,150,200,300,365 — GreetingSection.tsx:6) and a sessionStorage dedupe key dw_streak_celebrated_{count} (GreetingSection.tsx:14-16, 24-25).
first_visit: No dedicated "first visit" onboarding logic was in the requested file set beyond dw_first_open used to suppress the streak chip on day 1 (HomeScreen.tsx:449-454, "isFirstVisitDay") and dw_day1_begun key (storage.ts:41) — GAPS notes this is out of scope of the named files (onboarding flow itself was not requested).
return_visit: On every mount HomeScreen unconditionally calls recordStreakToday() (HomeScreen.tsx:786-795), which is a no-op if already recorded today (streak.ts:58) or advances the streak/shows a milestone toast if it's a new day. The streak count and any milestone re-render GreetingSection's greeting text and celebration banner (GreetingSection.tsx:9, 12-24).

summary: Habit machinery has four live parts: (1) a single streak engine in src/utils/streak.ts (key dw_streak_v2) that every completion path calls into, with idempotent-per-day logic, a once-per-7-days single-day freeze, and hardcoded milestones; (2) per-path completion stamps written to dw_reading_done (HomeScreen.tsx) via three distinct call sites (Mark-as-read button, lesson completion, auto-complete on last hero chapter) plus a passive app-open streak record on every mount; (3) a Netlify hourly cron (push-cron.js → push-send.js) that texts a hardcoded EN/ID scripture-snippet push per subscriber's stored preferred local hour, with a 2-hour catch-up window and a once-per-local-day send ledger, subscription managed by push-subscribe.js and the MoreScreen notifications UI; (4) a Sunday-only, streak-gated Weekly Review card and a GA4+Supabase dual-track analytics pipeline (src/utils/analytics.ts → analytics-dashboard.js → AnalyticsDashboard.tsx) that is descriptive only, not itself driving any habit nudge. All copy for push notifications and milestone/weekly-review text is hardcoded in source, not admin-editable — every wording or cadence change needs a developer.
